observations.body: Gifts equip a growing body toward maturity. But to each one of us, the grace was given according to the measure of the gift of Christ. from whom all the body, being fitted and knit together through that which every joint supplies, according to the working in measure of each individual part, makes the body increase to the building up of itself in love.

payload.tension: The passage states gifts equip a growing body toward maturity. But to each one of us, the grace was given according to the measure of the gift of Christ. from whom all the body, being fitted and knit together through that which every joint supplies, according to the working in measure of each individual part, makes the body increase to the building up of itself in love.
